log: `registerRules.ts` never registered `Rules/Unit/canStow.ts`, so with no `CanStow` rule `Transport#canStow` was `[].every(…)`, true for every pair: aircraft could land on any naval transport and land units could board a Carrier (civ-clone/web-renderer#246). It is now registered, and `tests/registerRules.test.ts` goes through `register(game)` so a rule left unregistered fails.

Two `Moved` rules after `move-cargo` stow units onto a `NavalTransport` whose own `Move` ended on its destination, while it has capacity and `canStow`s them: `collect-aircraft` takes the player's `Air` units on a tile without one of its cities, `collect-sleeping` takes the player's `Sleeping` units in one of its cities (civ-clone/web-renderer#263). `moved` takes a trailing `unitRegistry` for this, and its `cityRegistry` parameter is used again.

`moved/take-off` no longer requires an `Air` unit: a unit stowed in a city walks off with a plain `Move` (offered before `Disembark`), so it must be unloaded too or it sails away with the ship. It skips `Disembark`, which `moved/disembark` already unloads; every rule's criteria are checked before any effect runs.
